a.lede: Amazon has added a camera to its Echo Studio speaker as part of its big Echo refresh.
a.title: The Amazon Echo Studio's new camera can check on your dog or tell you how to play 'Monopoly'

b.lede: The Echo Studio with Home Camera essentially equips Alexa+ with eyes to enable ‘visual intelligence’ features – but there’s a kill switch.
b.title: Amazon’s new Echo Studio gives Alexa+ an AI camera to see inside your home
